name: Szellő (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with three narrow blue horizontal bands at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Szellő (a shield of blue and white with a church and a ploughshare, with blue and yellow mantling) above a scroll inscribed SZELLŐ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szellő arms with mantling and scroll
